hints.title: Mountain Peak Shape
hints.text: A beautiful tower configuration forms a mountain array, rising non-decreasingly up to peak index i, then falling non-increasingly.

hints.title: Prefix and Suffix Bounds
hints.text: For every candidate peak i, heights to the left are bounded by min(maxHeights[j], h[j+1]), and heights to the right are bounded by min(maxHeights[j], h[j-1]).

hints.title: Evaluate All Peaks
hints.text: Iterate each index i as the chosen peak, simulate tower heights left and right, and take the maximum sum.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Peak iteration with linear expansion for each peak.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all arbitrary mountain arrays is exponential, but heights must be bounded greedily by maxHeights.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize greedy tower bounding around each peak.
